context: A police officer briefs on coordination
purpose: Teach: オピニオン/図解/読み込み/終電/賃料/昇給/良品/単品

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 専門家のオピニオン、警察庁、参考にしています。
lines.en: We're consulting expert opinion from the National Police Agency.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Light informational tone. Steady eye contact. No urgency — this is protocol being stated clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。防犯マニュアル、図解化、進めます。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward on illustrated crime-prevention manuals.
lines.style: Straightforward, earnest commitment. Slight lean-in showing attentiveness. Warm but businesslike — confirming he's heard and will act.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の社員規程、読み込み、不審点ありません。
lines.en: I've reviewed your employee policies thoroughly. Nothing concerning.
lines.style: Methodical, reassuring. Flat affect on the summary. The small pause before 'nothing' signals genuine review, not just procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。終電後の防犯、警察と連携します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll coordinate post-hours security measures directly with the police.
lines.style: Assured, forward-looking. Crisp pacing. Gentle emphasis on 'directly' — showing alignment and responsibility.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域の賃料相場、犯罪傾向と連動する場面もあります。
lines.en: Rental costs in this area sometimes correlate with crime patterns.
lines.style: Observational, matter-of-fact. Paced slowly enough to land the connection. Slight upward lift at the end — informative but not alarming.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。昇給制度の透明性、警察庁、評価されています。
lines.en: Yes. The National Police Agency actually commends our salary transparency system.
lines.style: Slight pride beneath professional surface. Warm on 'commends' — he's genuinely pleased. Maintains composure but the effort shows.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 良品の流通、安全面、警察も注視しています。
lines.en: Product distribution and safety are priorities the police are monitoring closely.
lines.style: Authoritative but not heavy-handed. Steady pace. The weight of 'monitoring' lands naturally — this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。単品ごとの追跡、警察システムでも、可能です。
lines.en: Yes. Item-level tracking is actually possible through police databases.
lines.style: Assured, almost slightly relieved. Quick nod in voice. The 'actually' carries subtle confidence — this capability exists and can be used.
